fact: Angop reports the BNA announced it completed, in coordination with EMIS, BODIVA and banks, the migration of domestic payments in the real-time payment system (SPTR) to ISO 20022.
Expansão reports the Banco Nacional de Angola launched the Kwik instant-payment platform in June 2023, which carried Kz 557.4bn in the first half of 2026 per EMIS.
The BNA integrated the kwanza into the SADC-RTGS from 2026-07-27, with five Angolan commercial banks participating, per BNA governor Tiago Dias.
O País reports Africell's Afrimoney wallet is certified by the Banco Nacional de Angola, which gave it the status of payment service provider.
The Banco Nacional de Angola's Aviso 1/26 says only payment service companies it has authorised under the Payment System Law may act as non-bank acquirers.
